summary: Prolonged incarceration under PMLA; trial delay with 225 witnesses and only 1 examined; V. Senthil Balaji precedent applied; Constitutional right to speedy trial under Article 21; bail granted pending trial; Special Court to release appellant on conditions including attendance, cooperation, and passport surrender.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.3
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; appellant to be released on bail by Special Court within one week on specified conditions.
